audience: developers and office staff who make PDFs and images with Api2Pdf

useCases.title: Turn a web page, HTML or Markdown into a PDF
useCases.text: The AI renders a URL, an HTML string or Markdown text to a PDF with headless Chrome and returns a file link. For a protected page it can pass extra headers.

useCases.title: Convert a Word or Excel file to PDF
useCases.text: The AI takes the URL of an office file (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ODT and more) and converts it to a PDF with LibreOffice. You get a link to the new file.

useCases.title: Merge, compress, split or password-protect PDFs
useCases.text: The AI joins PDF links in the order you give, makes a PDF smaller, extracts a page range into a new PDF, or adds an open password and an optional owner password.

useCases.title: Make a screenshot, an image from HTML, or a barcode
useCases.text: The AI makes an image from a live web page or an HTML string, or a barcode or QR code image (QRCode, Code128, PDF417, DataMatrix) for a value you give.

useCases.title: Convert a PDF or Office file to Markdown text
useCases.text: The AI turns a document at a URL (PDF, Office files and more) into Markdown, so you can read it or have the AI work with its contents.
